items.summary: Twelve senators (Republicans McConnell, Tillis, Collins, Armstrong, Murkowski, Cornyn; Democrats Blumenthal, Shaheen, Durbin, Whitehouse, Reed, Coons) wrote to Trump on Oct 13 urging him to rescind OFAC General License No. 135, which temporarily eased sanctions to let Russian diesel into global markets. They called the deal a "gift to our adversary," arguing Kremlin revenue would finance Russia's war and advance security cooperation with China, Iran and North Korea, endanger servicemembers in Operation Epic Fury, and offer negligible fuel-price relief despite the Iran war's pressure on diesel. They want the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 enforced instead. A separate Sunday statement by seven senators said the deal runs counter to the 2022 Ending Importation of Russian Oil Act. Trump defended the deal Tuesday en route to Alaska, calling it "a deal for the world." Catch-up item: published before this run's last_check but missed by earlier checks.
items.title: Bipartisan senators urge Trump to rescind Russian diesel deal tied to Iran-war fuel prices
